versions.changelog: Add skill cards and standardized growth registry metadata
Switch public terms to CC BY-NC-SA + commercial license

Initial public release of Short Video Hook Lab.

- Generate, test, and refine short-video hooks for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
- Workflow covers context capture, 12 hook variant generation (across 6 hook families), scoring, and selection.
- Provides micro execution packs for best-performing hooks, including hook line, 10-second flow, on-screen text, CTA, and filming complexity.
- Output emphasizes clarity, platform-native tone, and authenticity over clickbait.
